# otto: the world outside the record

## The boathouse

Closed from November to March, which is why the winter goal is about the
ergometer rather than the water. He rows on the club erg on Tuesdays and
Thursdays and rides at the weekend when it is dry.

## The photographs

He does not trust himself to remember a split by the time he is home, so he
photographs the console. The images themselves are NOT in this corpus - it
ships no bytes - so each artifact row carries a content address computed from
a label rather than from a file. The address is a real content address in
shape, which is what a validator and a store care about, and it is stable
across regeneration, which is what the corpus cares about.

One photo was deleted in April because somebody else was in the frame and had
not been asked. The row stays and says so. That is the difference between a
removal and data loss, and it only exists because somebody recorded a reason.

## The clinic

One appointment, in January, for a whole-body scan. Their machine, their
procedure, neither of which he controls or can repeat at home. He has not been
back.

## What is deliberately absent

No power meter: he has never owned one, so his rides carry heart rate and
cadence and no watts. No second ergometer in the record, which is what makes
his claim about the club machine reading long untestable from his own data -
deliberately, because a record that cannot settle a question is a real case
and the corpus had no clean example of one.
